films.title: Jason and the Argonauts
films.description: Harryhausen's skeleton army made the Argonautica modern cinema's favourite voyage — the fleece quest as stop-motion spectacle.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.description: Apollonius' epic remains the blueprint of the crew-quest — Argo, the Clashing Rocks, and the fleece at the world's edge.
